hebrewText: וַ/יִּבְקְעוּ֩ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הַ/גִּבֹּרִ֜ים בְּ/מַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַ/יִּֽשְׁאֲבוּ מַ֨יִם֙ מִ/בֹּ֤אר בֵּֽית לֶ֨חֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/שַּׁ֔עַר וַ/יִּשְׂא֖וּ וַ/יָּבִ֣אוּ אֶל דָּוִ֑ד וְ/לֹ֤א אָבָה֙ לִ/שְׁתּוֹתָ֔/ם וַ/יַּסֵּ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖/ם לַֽ/יהוָֽה

tokens.bdb: to cleave; generally, to rend, break, rip or open
tokens.kjv: make a breach, break forth (into, out, in pieces, through, up), be ready to burst, cleave (asunder), cut out, divide, hatch, rend (asunder), rip up, tear, win.

tokens.bdb: three; occasionally (ordinal) third, or (multiple) thrice
tokens.kjv: [phrase] fork, [phrase] often(-times), third, thir(-teen, -teenth), three, [phrase] thrice. Compare H7991 (שָׁלִישׁ).

tokens.bdb: powerful; by implication, warrior, tyrant
tokens.kjv: champion, chief, [idiom] excel, giant, man, mighty (man, one), strong (man), valiant man.

tokens.bdb: an encampment (of travellers or troops); hence, an army, whether literal (of soldiers) or figurative (of dancers, angels, cattle, locusts, stars; or even the sacred courts)
tokens.kjv: army, band, battle, camp, company, drove, host, tents.

tokens.bdb: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.kjv: Philistine.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.enLiteralWord: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.explanation: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.explanationEn: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth

tokens.bdb: to bale up water
tokens.kjv: (woman to) draw(-er, water).

tokens.bdb: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
tokens.kjv: [phrase] piss, wasting, water(-ing, (-course, -flood, -spring)).
tokens.explanation: mayim — água, rio, mar (sempre plural em hebraico)

tokens.bdb: a cistern
tokens.kjv: cistern.

tokens.bdb: Beth-Lechem, a place in Palestine
tokens.kjv: Bethlehem.

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.bdb: an opening, i.e. door or gate
tokens.kjv: city, door, gate, port ([idiom] -er).

tokens.bdb: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
tokens.kjv: accept, advance, arise, (able to, (armor), suffer to) bear(-er, up), bring (forth), burn, carry (away), cast, contain, desire, ease, exact, exalt (self), extol, fetch, forgive, furnish, further, give, go on, help, high, hold up, honorable ([phrase] man), lade, lay, lift (self) up, lofty, marry, magnify, [idiom] needs, obtain, pardon, raise (up), receive, regard, respect, set (up), spare, stir up, [phrase] swear, take (away, up), [idiom] utterly, wear, yield.

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.
tokens.explanation: bo — vir, ir, entrar, chegar, avançar em direção a algo

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: David, the youngest son of Jesse
tokens.kjv: David.
tokens.explanation: David — Davi, rei de Israel, autor de muitos salmos

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.bdb: to breathe after, i.e. (figuratively) to be acquiescent
tokens.kjv: consent, rest content will, be willing.

tokens.bdb: to imbibe (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] assuredly, banquet, [idiom] certainly, drink(-er, -ing), drunk ([idiom] -ard), surely. (Prop. intensive of H8248 (שָׁקָה).)

tokens.bdb: to pour out, especially a libation, or to cast (metal); by analogy, to anoint aking
tokens.kjv: cover, melt, offer, (cause to) pour (out), set (up).

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"
